items.headline: Israeli President Grants Opposition Leader Gadi Eisenkot Mandate to Form Government
items.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog formally gave opposition politician Gadi Eisenkot the first opportunity to form a new government following recent elections. The former military chief now has six weeks to assemble a coalition, marking a significant potential leadership transition from long-serving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

items.headline: Anthropic Agrees to $3.4 Billion Energy Deal for AI Data Centers
items.summary: Artificial intelligence developer Anthropic has struck a $3.4 billion deal with Texas-based OnePWR Solutions to secure 1.7 gigawatts of natural gas generators for its data centers. The multi-billion-dollar agreement highlights how the exponential growth of advanced AI models is forcing tech firms to acquire massive dedicated energy supplies.

items.headline: Mercedes Clinches F1 Constructors' Title as Lando Norris Wins in São Paulo
items.summary: McLaren driver Lando Norris won a rain-affected São Paulo Grand Prix on November 8, 2026, beating Max Verstappen to take victory from pole position. Mercedes officially clinched the 2026 Formula 1 Constructors' Championship after team drivers George Russell and Kimi Antonelli secured top-five finishes.

items.headline: Godzilla Minus Zero Sets Box Office Record with $31.6 Million Debut
items.summary: Director Takashi Yamazaki's sci-fi sequel Godzilla Minus Zero topped the North American box office with an estimated $31.6 million opening weekend. This milestone marks the highest-grossing domestic opening weekend debut in history for a live-action foreign-language film.
